turns.speaker: Me
turns.text: Alright, we said we would come back to the onboarding screen once the copy was settled, so let us start there.

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text: The copy is settled. What is not settled is whether the permission prompt comes before or after the first recording.

turns.speaker: Yuval
turns.text: Before. If someone taps record and then gets asked for the microphone, the first take is already half lost.

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text: That is true, but asking for the microphone on a screen that has not explained anything yet is exactly the prompt people deny.

turns.speaker: Me
turns.text: So we explain first and ask second, on the same screen. One sentence about what the app does, then the button that triggers the prompt.

turns.speaker: Yuval
turns.text: I can have that laid out by Thursday. Does it need the illustration, or can it ship with the wordmark?

turns.speaker: Me
turns.text: The wordmark is enough for now. Let us see whether the sentence carries it before we spend a week drawing.

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text: Agreed. I will write the sentence today and send it to both of you before I put it anywhere near the design.
